answer: Prayers & Duties >> Qurbani (Slaughtering) Question ID: 31442 Country: India Title: I could not do Qurbani on Bakra Eid Question: Zakat applies on me. But Last Bakra Eid I had not sufficient money in my hand for Qurbani, So I could not do Qurbani on Bakra Eid. Right Now I have sufficient money. What should I do now. How can I adjust this thing. Answer ID: 31442 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 668/476/L=1432) If you mean by your word "last baqra Eid you had not sufficient money in your hand for Qurbani" that you were not owner of nisab i.e. Qurbani was not wajib on you, then nothing is wajib on you now. And if you mean that you were owner of nisab but that time you had no money, then in case of having money you will have to do sadaqah of an average goat. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
